changes: Slides keep their speed along the ground: up a ramp they launch along it, and up into a wall they carry you straight up it.
No more speed caps on slides: long hills keep speeding you up until the air holds you back.
Air drag: falls and fast slides now have a top speed, and friction eases off on steep slopes.
Jumping into a sloped ceiling slides you along it instead of stopping dead.
Moving along a wall while pushing into it no longer catches on every block.
